## Install

Download **dvnote-Setup.exe** below and run it. It installs for your user account, with no administrator rights needed.
Running it over an existing install updates it in place. If dvnote is already installed, you can also use
**Help > Check for updates**.

`dvnote.exe` is the same program without the installer. Each `.sha256` file holds the SHA-256 checksum of its download.
